content.subject: ShipBob funding and reconciliation
content.draft_text:
Hi Test,
ShipBob raised $200 million in a Bain‑led round. Such funding often triggers intercompany reconciliation sprawl across new business units, increasing manual matching effort.
We build configurable scripts that pull transaction data from your TMS, ERP, and carrier portals into a single ledger, reconciling entries without manual entry and generating audit‑ready logs for each run.
Worth a 15‑minute call next week?
Zamp
